headline: St. John Fisher sets the E8 pace
dek: St. John Fisher has won fifteen matches without a draw and lost only three, scoring 52 goals across all competitions while conceding sixteen. That defense and attack put the program clear of a chasing pack led by Nazareth and Brockport as the season closes.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring concentrates heavily at the top of the table, with St. John Fisher's 52 goals outpacing Hartwick, Alfred, Russell Sage, SUNY Poly, and Geneseo combined.

wire.line: Against non-conference opponents, programs have 30 wins, eleven draws, and 29 losses, scoring 145 goals and conceding 98.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their scheduled date still carry no published result, and both belong to Elmira: home meetings with SUNY Delhi and William Smith.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Alfred goalkeeper Lauren Mott has faced heavy volume, making 88 saves while conceding 25 goals for a 0.779 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nazareth has won thirteen matches, drawn three, and lost four across all competitions, scoring 50 goals while conceding seventeen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Keuka has scored 31 goals while conceding 33, leaving the program with four wins, three draws, and nine losses.

last_match.line: Nazareth had been unbeaten since October before this defeat ended its run.

next_match.line: Houghton returns from a loss at Nazareth as the final E8 side still playing.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
